scope: Approve the concrete Boolean-only recommendation for a separately reviewed successor contract. This does not mutate or register expression-contract/0, prove correspondence, approve a compiler/runtime/K implementation, or discharge full RP01 or financial acceptance.
decision: Change the next Core And/Or semantics to the source contract’s left-to-right short-circuit evaluation while retaining exhaustive static checking, full input admission, finite conservative bounds, node-entry work and original child diagnostic provenance. No additional constructor is needed.

observations.finding: Source explicitly selects short-circuit and/or and conservative static-bound admission.

Published EX-D1 deliberately selects strict operands; the following source-conflict paragraph leaves reconciliation open. Historical approval is coherent in that narrower scope and cannot be reused for this changed behavior.
Grammar and parser have or/and precedence tiers, left associativity and named Binary operator/left/right nodes. This is source inspection, not an elaboration result.
All children are statically visited, whole Pre/Args/Obs snapshots are checked before work-metered reduction, Bool has no truthiness/coercion, and statements cannot be Boolean operands.
The exact inability-to-enter error is WORK_EXHAUSTED. Failed entry consumes no work; a successfully entered failing arithmetic constructor and its entered children do consume work.

contextAndWorkAudit.contexts: The proposed replacement is equivalent to allowing And(E,e2) and Or(E,e2), alongside existing contexts for every other constructor. The generic strict K context must exclude And/Or. After their left values return, the four specified contractions select a value or the right expression. No unrestricted And(v,E)/Or(v,E) rule may survive in the revised contract.
contextAndWorkAudit.provenance: Administrative contractions carry no entry charge. They retain the selected right occurrence at p+[1] with its own span. Enclosing constructor frames retain their own provenance. Left failures occur under p+[0]. The proposal explicitly prevents right-path rebasing and parent re-entry.
contextAndWorkAudit.finiteWork: On successful evaluation the selected path consumes 1+C(left), plus C(right) only when selected. This is at most the proposed 1+B(left)+B(right) by structural induction on the bounded syntax. Failure retains a finite entered-node prefix. This mathematical source argument is not a mechanized proof or native proof-cost estimate.
contextAndWorkAudit.zeroRemaining: A short-circuit contraction may finish at zero remaining work because it creates no entered literal node. A selected unentered right node at zero remaining work rejects WORK_EXHAUSTED at that child.

specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL01to04: And(false,true) false/2; And(true,false) false/3; Or(true,false) true/2; Or(false,true) true/3.
specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL05to06: Skipped right Eq(FloorDiv(1,0),0) does not evaluate: false/2 for And and true/2 for Or.
specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL07to08: Selected right arithmetic rejects ARITH_DENOMINATOR at [1,0] after six entries; the enclosing Eq right literal is not entered.
specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL09: Left arithmetic rejects ARITH_DENOMINATOR at [0,0] after five entries; the right Bool is not entered.
specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL10to11: Undeclared ReadArg(Missing) rejects TYPE_NAME at [1], work0; non-Bool right literal rejects TYPE_MISMATCH at the And root, work0. Both are static failures despite the false left literal.
specifiedCasesAudit.BOOL12to14: initialWork2 with selected right rejects WORK_EXHAUSTED at [1], work2; skipping with work2 succeeds false; initialWork1 rejects WORK_EXHAUSTED before left entry at [0], work1.
specifiedCasesAudit.limitations: These are schematic isolated-expression expectations with assumed well-formed metadata and snapshots. The count script only compares workUsed to the handwritten entry-list length. It does not validate semantics, admission, spans or a runtime. Concrete span and snapshot cases remain future implementation obligations.

independentHandDerivedCorners.term: And(false,ReadArg(x)); declared x:Bool, Args missing x
independentHandDerivedCorners.note: Snapshot admission rejects before reduction; no diagnostic path claimed without a concrete wire fixture.

financialGuards.reason: The proposed change affects pure Bool operand evaluation. Require and Ensure still test their resulting Boolean and reject false; static placement/authority rules and complete snapshot checks are unchanged. Financial fields remain outside raw NextWrite authority, and Emit remains a separate statement producing descriptors. Gross-debit, net-goal, residual-duty, history, signing and ledger/proof acceptance obligations are not replaced by successful expression evaluation.
financialGuards.behaviorChange: A dynamic error in a skipped pure branch ceases to reject. For example Require(Or(true,badArithmeticBool)) can succeed; Require(And(false,badArithmeticBool)) instead reaches GUARD_FAILED. This deliberate semantic difference must be reflected in the new profile and cannot be called equivalence with strict expression-contract/0.

strongestCounterargument: Strict evaluation exposes every dynamic child error and has branch-independent ordinary expression entry cost. Short-circuit semantics instead matches the stated developer source contract and requires explicit branch-sensitive diagnostic/cost rules. The proposal supplies those rules while retaining exhaustive validation and conservative admission. Neither choice establishes privacy or native proof cost.
successorImplementationObligations: Create a new candidate/revision and fresh votes before changing any frozen normative or profile bytes; update context grammar, CMP rules, signature evaluation-order metadata, derivations and cases together.
Keep all 8 And/Or truth-table combinations, skip/selection failures, both work-exhaustion directions, nested original paths and concrete spans in later implementation validation.
Add concrete rejected snapshot and invalid literal/span/aggregate-bound cases in skipped branches; keep whole-action static-before-runtime precedence.

Demonstrate parser/elaboration/evaluator/K correspondence separately, with source and semantic profile hashes distinguished. The source proposal only resolves the Boolean design conflict, not the full source/Core correspondence obligation.
